================================================================================
typeof import() and bare import() inside call type_arguments
================================================================================

const a = foo<typeof import("m")>();
const b = foo<import("m")>();
const c = foo<typeof import("m").T>();
const d = foo<typeof import("m"), number>();
const e = await foo<typeof import("m")>();
const f: Foo<Bar<typeof bar>> = x;
